login.title: Sign in

login.tagline: From the first order to the last rupee, in one calm place.

printHelp.title: Printing
printHelp.hint: Receipts and kitchen tickets print by themselves. Set this up once, on the counter computer.
printHelp.intro: A website cannot see your printer, so a small print helper runs on the counter computer. It finds the printer by itself (a thermal receipt printer is chosen automatically), prints receipts and kitchen tickets the moment they are made, and starts with Windows.
printHelp.step1: Plug in the printer and install its driver on the counter computer, so that it appears in Windows Settings under Printers.
printHelp.step2: Press the button below. A file called "Install print helper" is downloaded.
printHelp.step3: Open that file once (if Windows asks, choose Keep, then Run anyway). It installs the helper and starts it.
printHelp.setup: Set up printing on this computer
printHelp.offline: Not connected right now. Receipts open in the browser print window until it is back.
printHelp.waiting: Waiting for the helper to connect…
printHelp.openFile: Open the downloaded file "Install print helper" on the counter computer. This page will say Connected within a few seconds.
printHelp.offlineHint: Is the counter computer switched on? The helper starts by itself with Windows. If it still does not connect, install it again.
printHelp.testSent: Test page sent to the printer
printHelp.printerAuto: Chosen automatically. Change it only if the wrong printer was picked.
printHelp.noPrinter: The helper is connected but no printer is installed on that computer. Install the printer's driver, then it appears here.
printHelp.withoutTitle: No helper? Print from the browser
printHelp.without: If the helper is not running, the receipt opens in the browser's print window after payment: choose the printer once there. Kitchen tickets then appear only on the kitchen screen.

crash.title: This screen could not open

offline.pendingHelp: Not saved yet. These are kept on this device and sent when the internet is back. The kitchen has not received them.
offline.notSent: Not sent to the kitchen yet
offline.kitchenNotTold: The kitchen has NOT received them: tell the kitchen yourself.
offline.failedHint: The server refused these when the internet came back (for example the order was closed or the dish sold out). Check each one and tell the kitchen if needed.

dash.howTitle: How these numbers are worked out
dash.how1: Net sales = menu sales − discounts + service charge − refunds. Tax is excluded.
dash.how2: Cost of food = the ingredient cost of every dish sold, from its recipe and the average purchase price.
dash.how3: Net profit = net sales − cost of food − expenses entered under Costs. Salaries and rent only reduce profit once they are entered as expenses.
dash.how4: Days follow the business day, so a late night after midnight still counts for the day it opened.
dash.how5: Everything comes from paid bills and recorded entries. Nothing here can be edited.
dash.tip: Rent and salaries are counted on the day they are entered, so a single day can show a loss. Choose This month for the true picture.

dash.kMedianSub: Median of {{n}} tickets, sent to ready
dash.kCaveat: {{untimed}} tickets were never marked ready on the screen and {{ignored}} took over 3 hours (likely forgotten taps). They are left out of these times.

tables.title: Tables
tables.what: The home screen. It shows every table and whether it is free, busy or waiting for payment.
steps: Tap a free table to start an order for the guests sitting there.
Tap a busy table to see its order or add more.
Use New takeaway or New delivery for orders without a table.
tips: A table that pulses has just changed: food is ready, or the guest asked for the bill.
If the top bar says the day has not started, tap it and start the day first.

order.title: Taking an order
order.what: Build the guests' order here: dishes on the left, the order on the right.
steps: Tap a dish to add it. Tap again to add one more.
Press Send to kitchen. The kitchen gets the ticket and the items show "In kitchen".
When the guests ask for the bill, press Bill, then take the payment.
tips: Use the search box or the category tabs; Popular shows what sells most.
Items already in the kitchen cannot be changed: use Void and give a reason.
More lets you hold the order, move it to another table, merge tables or cancel it.

pay.title: Taking payment
pay.what: Take the payment for a bill.
steps: Choose how the guest pays: cash, card, wallet or khata (credit).
For cash, type the amount received. The change is shown.
Press Take payment. The receipt prints.
tips: To split between two methods, take the first payment, then the rest.
A discount needs a reason, and a large one needs a manager's PIN.

kitchen.title: Kitchen board
kitchen.what: The cooking board. Each card is one order for one kitchen station.
steps: New: press Start cooking when the cook begins.
Cooking: press Ready when the food is done.
Ready: the waiter presses Served when it reaches the table.
tips: A red timer means the ticket has waited too long.
Use the station tabs to see only your station (BBQ, Tandoor…).

bills.title: Bills
bills.what: Every bill, newest first. Open one to reprint it or give a refund.
steps: Search or scroll to find the bill.
Tap it to see the lines and payments.
Reprint the receipt, or refund (needs permission and a reason).
tips: Bills are never edited or deleted. A mistake is corrected with a refund (credit note).

khata.title: Khata (credit)
steps: Create an account with a credit limit.
At payment choose Khata and pick the customer.
When they pay, open their account and record the payment.
tips: The till refuses a sale that would go over the credit limit.

dashboard.title: Business overview
dashboard.what: How the business is doing: sales, costs and profit.
steps: Pick a period at the top.
Read the headline numbers, then the profit and loss.
Check "Watch for leaks" for discounts, voids and cash differences.
tips: Share summary sends the day's result to WhatsApp.
Profit counts only dishes that have a recipe cost.

admin.title: Admin
admin.what: Set up the restaurant: menu, tables, stock, staff and settings.
steps: Pick an area at the top: Menu & tables, Stock & costs, People & access or Business.
Then pick the screen inside it.
Start with Setup to see what is still missing.
tips: Changing a price never changes old bills.

platform.title: Platform admin
platform.subtitle: Control room

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.hint: Work out everybody’s pay for a period, fix it, approve it (that locks it), then record the payments.
payroll.noRuns: No pay runs yet. Start one for last month.
payroll.newHint: Everybody employed in that period whose pay is set to this frequency is included. A monthly salary only fits a monthly run.
payroll.draftHint: This is a draft. Check each person, add bonuses or fines where needed, then approve. Approving locks the pay run and the attendance of its days.
payroll.lockedHint: Approved: nothing here can change. A mistake is fixed as a line in the next pay run.
payroll.noSlips: Nobody is in this pay run.
payroll.lineHint: Written down with your name. It stays in this pay run only.
payroll.payHint: This is recorded once as a salary expense. Pressing twice does not pay twice.
payroll.draftSlip: Draft: the figures can still change.
payroll.rulesNote: No legal rate is built in. Type what you have confirmed with your accountant (Open Questions #46). Until then overtime stays off and lateness costs nothing.

rule.divisor: A day’s pay is the monthly salary divided by
rule.lates: Late arrivals that cost one day’s pay
rule.offDays: Daily-wage staff are paid for weekly offs and holidays

dues.title: Advances & fines
dues.hint: Money staff owe the restaurant: salary advances, loans and fines. It is taken back from their pay a bit at a time.
dues.writeOffText: Forgive the {{amount}} still owed? It stays in the record as written off and nothing more is taken from their pay.
dues.recoveryHint: The instalment is taken as a deduction on each payslip, never more than is owed and never more than the pay left. It is booked when the pay run is approved.

kindHint.ADVANCE: Cash given now against salary. By default all of it is taken at the next pay.
kindHint.LOAN: Cash given now and taken back in instalments: say how much each pay run.
kindHint.FINE: Nothing is paid out; the amount is taken from pay.

overview.title: Staff overview
overview.hint: Who is here, how the month is going, and what the staff cost.
overview.pendingLeave: {{count}} leave request(s) waiting for a decision
overview.labourCost: Pay as a share of sales
overview.labourHint: Approved pay runs ending this month against settled bills.

counterPrinter.title: One printer at the counter
counterPrinter.hint: For a restaurant with a single printer at the counter: kitchen tickets and bills come out of it, and every order gets a token number.
counterPrinter.oneHint: Switches on all three: one kitchen ticket per order with the token, the bill printed before payment (no second print after paying), and the Kitchen screen hidden.
counterPrinter.singleTicket: One kitchen ticket for the whole order
counterPrinter.singleTicketHint: A Send comes out as ONE ticket with the token number on top and every station under its own heading, instead of one small slip per station.
counterPrinter.afterPay: Print the receipt by itself after payment
counterPrinter.afterPayHint: Switch off when the counter prints the bill first and then takes payment. A receipt can still be printed on request.
counterPrinter.kitchenScreenHint: Switch off when nobody uses the Kitchen board: the printed ticket is the kitchen. The Kitchen link disappears and Send to kitchen only prints.
